# Garage Slice 1C — Apple App Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A SwiftUI app for iPhone and Mac that shows the car's live state from Supabase within seconds, sends signed commands through the Green's proxy over Tailscale, and onboards without a terminal.

**Architecture:** One Xcode project generated by XcodeGen (`apps/apple/project.yml`) with a single multiplatform app target `Garage` (iOS 26, macOS 26) that is deliberately thin. Everything testable lives in the Swift package `GarageKit`: `Design` (tokens, type, glass, icons), `Models`, `VehicleStore` (Supabase Realtime + snapshot cache), `CommandClient` (proxy + token + usage), `Onboarding` state machine, and the SwiftUI feature views. The backend contract is the one already deployed (spec §7) plus one small bridge release (Task 1) that gives the proxy a browser-trusted certificate and publishes its URL so the app needs no manual network setup.

**Tech Stack:** Swift 6, SwiftUI, Xcode 26.6, XcodeGen 2.46, `supabase-swift` 2.x (Auth, PostgREST, Realtime v2), MapKit, AuthenticationServices (Sign in with Apple, `ASWebAuthenticationSession`), Network.framework (`NWConnection` reachability probe), `swift-snapshot-testing` 1.17+, Lucide icons (ISC), Big Shoulders Display + Instrument Sans (OFL).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-18-garage-slice-1-foundation-and-status-design.md` §3, §4.3, §4.5, §4.6, §6, §7, §7.2, §8, §9, §10, §11, §12, §15. Design reference: Figma file DataTes, page Directions, frame "D4 / Hybrid" (node 2:2); `packages/tokens/tokens.json` is the binding token source.

## Global Constraints

- Plan 1A/1B constraints hold: metric storage, no automatic wakes, every billable call counted, conventional commits with trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>`, nothing under `.superpowers/` committed, no secrets in the repo (the Supabase **publishable** key `sb_publishable_pTtfxdLeqJjs43C-VtdTEw_75Ag3k9r` and URL `https://mfxnhehffsuzaxjivvwr.supabase.co` are public and may be committed; the service key, bridge secret, Tesla secrets never).
- Identifiers fixed here: bundle id `com.duncanbottrill.garage` (macOS: same), URL scheme `garage` (callback `garage://connected`, already what `/auth/callback` redirects to), app display name `Garage`, Xcode scheme `Garage`, Swift package `GarageKit` at `apps/apple/GarageKit`. Signing: `CODE_SIGN_STYLE = Automatic`, `DEVELOPMENT_TEAM` read from the git-ignored `apps/apple/Signing.xcconfig` (owner creates it from `Signing.xcconfig.example`; the team id is `UA9XSPSJ4U`, the Mac's "Apple Development" identity).
- Targets: iOS 26.0 and macOS 26.0 minimum. Swift language mode 6, strict concurrency. One app target with `supportedDestinations: [iOS, macOS]` (not Catalyst).
- Backend contract (deployed): `POST /auth/start` → `{url}` (Supabase JWT bearer); `GET /api/token` → `{access_token, expires_at}` | 404 `not_connected` | 503 `token_unavailable` + `retry_at`; `GET /api/connection` → `{connected, rotated_at, last_error, access_expires_at, rotating, refresh_failures, next_refresh_at}`; `POST /api/vehicles/sync` → `{vehicles:[...]}` or 502; `POST /api/vehicle-data` → 200 `{state}` | 409 `asleep` | 429 `rate_limited`/`budget_minimal` | 404; `POST /api/usage` body `{category: "commands"|"wakes", count}`. All with `Authorization: Bearer <supabase access token>`. Base URL `https://garage.duncanbottrill.com`.
- Proxy contract: `POST https://<proxy_base_url>/api/1/vehicles/{vin}/command/{name}` with `Authorization: Bearer <tesla access token>` and a JSON body; `POST .../vehicles/{vin}/wake_up`. Proxy base URL comes from `vehicles.proxy_base_url` (Task 1), form `https://garage-bridge.<tailnet>.ts.net:4443`, overridable in More. Slice-1 command names (verbatim): `door_lock`, `door_unlock`, `auto_conditioning_start`, `auto_conditioning_stop`, `set_temps` (`{driver_temp, passenger_temp}` °C), `remote_seat_heater_request` (`{heater, level}`), `set_preconditioning_max` (`{on, manual_override}`), `charge_port_door_open`, `charge_port_door_close`, `charge_start`, `charge_stop`, `set_charge_limit` (`{percent}`), `set_scheduled_charging` (`{enable, time}` minutes after midnight), `actuate_trunk` (`{which_trunk: "front"}`), `flash_lights`, `honk_horn`.
- Wake policy: if `sleep_state == "asleep"` (or a command returns Tesla's "vehicle unavailable"/408), the app shows a confirmation; only after a tap does it send `wake_up`, then reports `{category:"wakes"}`. Never automatic.
- Data model consumed (spec §6, verified against migration 0001 + 0016): `vehicles(id, owner_id, vin, display_name, model, budget_mode, telemetry_confirmed_at, proxy_base_url)`; `vehicle_state` columns exactly: `soc, range_km, charge_state, charger_power_kw, charge_limit_soc, charge_port_open, scheduled_charge_at, charge_at, inside_c, outside_c, hvac_on, climate_keeper, climate_at, lat, lng, heading, speed_kph, gear, odometer_km, location_at, locked, doors, windows, frunk_open, trunk_open, body_at, tpms_bar, sentry, sleep_state, software_version, bridge_seen_at, bridge_health, updated_at, charge_amps`; `doors`/`windows` keys `driver_front, passenger_front, driver_rear, passenger_rear`; `tpms_bar` keys `fl, fr, rl, rr`; `bridge_health` keys `dropped, flushed, received, connectivity, active_alerts, last_event_at, patch_failures`. Realtime publication exists on `vehicle_state` only; RLS lets the owner `select` `vehicles`, `vehicle_state`, `signals`, `api_usage`.
- Freshness (spec §10): bridge offline when `bridge_seen_at` older than **90 s**; a field is **stale** when its `*_at` is older than **10 min**; "Refresh now" shown only when telemetry is older than **10 min** and `sleep_state != "asleep"`.
- Design tokens (spec §9, `tokens.json`): background `#0B0F14`, glass `#0F151C` at 0.86 (strong 0.9), ink `#EAF0F6`, muted `#7D8A99`, accent `#4FE3FF` (route, car, active state only), charging `#3DDC97`, warning `#FFB020`, danger `#F26D6D`, hairline white 0.08; radii sheet 28 / pill 22 / control 18 / tile 16 / dock 30; spacing 4/8/12/16/20/24/32; blur glass 24 / dock 28. Type: Big Shoulders Display SemiBold for hero and tile numerals only (scale `numeralHero` 84, `numeralL` 34, `numeralM` 30, `numeralS` 22; never below 22 pt, never in tables); Instrument Sans for everything else (`title` 17/500, `body` 14, `caption` 12, `label` 11/500 small caps +12 % tracking, `labelS` 10). Tabular figures in any column of numbers. Icons Lucide, 1.5 pt stroke, no custom glyphs. Motion: numerals roll (`.contentTransition(.numericText())`), car dot breathes while live and is solid when stale.
- Copy rules: units shown in the user's locale measurement system (km/mi, °C/°F) converted from metric at display time; times relative ("2 min ago") under 1 h, clock time otherwise; no exclamation marks; error copy is plain language and names the next action.
- Build/test commands: `cd apps/apple && xcodegen generate` then `xcodebuild -project Garage.xcodeproj -scheme Garage -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' build` and `... -destination 'platform=macOS' build`; package tests `cd apps/apple/GarageKit && swift test` (pure-logic tests) plus `xcodebuild test -scheme GarageKit -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro'` for snapshot tests. `Garage.xcodeproj` is generated and git-ignored.

## Review Focus

1. **Realtime payload with `null` or missing columns** (the bridge omits fields it has not seen; a `vehicle_state` UPDATE carries the full row, but early rows have most columns `null`): the UI must render placeholders ("—") per field, never crash or show `0`. Test in Task 4 (`decodesSparseRow`) and Task 7 (snapshot `status_sparse`).
2. **Proxy answers with a non-JSON body** (nginx-style HTML from the serve layer, or an empty 502 when the proxy is down): `CommandClient` must map it to `.unreachable`/`.rejected(reason:)` with readable copy, not throw a decoding error up to the view. Test in Task 5 (`mapsNonJSONBodyToRejected`).
3. **Tesla token expiring between fetch and send** (`/api/token` returns a token with `expires_at` in the past, or the proxy returns 401): one forced refresh then one retry, then surface "Reconnect Tesla" rather than loop. Test in Task 5 (`refreshesTokenOnceOn401`).
4. **Double tap on a control** while the first command is in flight: the second tap is ignored (per-command in-flight guard keyed by command name), not sent twice and not double-counted in usage. Test in Task 5 (`ignoresDuplicateTapWhileInFlight`).
5. **Device clock skew / future timestamps** from the bridge: freshness must clamp negative ages to 0 and still classify correctly; a `bridge_seen_at` 30 s in the future is "live", not "stale". Test in Task 4 (`freshnessClampsFutureTimestamps`).

## File structure

```
apps/apple/
  project.yml                      XcodeGen spec (target Garage, package GarageKit, tests)
  Signing.xcconfig.example         DEVELOPMENT_TEAM placeholder (real file git-ignored)
  Garage/                          thin app target
    GarageApp.swift                @main, environment wiring, URL handling (garage://)
    Info.plist, Garage.entitlements (Sign in with Apple, App Sandbox + network client on macOS)
    Config.plist                   SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, API_BASE_URL (public)
    Assets.xcassets                AppIcon placeholder, accent colour
  GarageKit/
    Package.swift
    Sources/GarageKit/
      Design/   Tokens.swift (generated), GarageFont.swift, Glass.swift, Hairline.swift, Label.swift, Icon.swift, Resources/Fonts/*.ttf, Resources/Icons.xcassets, Resources/LICENSES/
      Models/   VehicleState.swift, Vehicle.swift, Freshness.swift, Units.swift, BridgeHealth.swift
      Store/    SupabaseEnvironment.swift, VehicleStore.swift, SnapshotCache.swift, RealtimeFeed.swift
      Commands/ CommandClient.swift, TokenProvider.swift, ProxyReachability.swift, UsageReporter.swift, Command.swift, CommandError.swift
      Backend/  GarageAPI.swift (auth/start, token, connection, vehicles/sync, vehicle-data, usage)
      Onboarding/ OnboardingFlow.swift (state machine), views
      Features/ Status/, Climate/, Charge/, More/, Placeholders/ (Drives, Charges, Battery)
      App/      RootView.swift (TabView vs NavigationSplitView), AppModel.swift
    Tests/GarageKitTests/  unit tests + Fixtures/*.json
    Tests/GarageKitSnapshotTests/ snapshot tests + __Snapshots__/
  scripts/fetch-fonts.sh, scripts/fetch-icons.sh
packages/tokens/src/generate.ts    also writes apps/apple/GarageKit/Sources/GarageKit/Design/Tokens.swift
garage-bridge/                     Task 1 only: proxy cert from tailscale, proxy_base_url publish
supabase/migrations/0017_proxy_base_url.sql
```

- Modify: `garage-bridge/rootfs/etc/s6-overlay/s6-rc.d/tlscert/run` (hostname mode: also run `tailscale cert` for the tailnet FQDN into `/data/proxy-tls/`), `garage-bridge/rootfs/etc/s6-overlay/s6-rc.d/proxy/run` (prefer `/data/proxy-tls/{cert,key}.pem` from `tailscale cert`; self-signed only when tailscale is disabled), `garage-bridge/ingest/src/index.ts` + `garage-bridge/ingest/src/supabase-sink.ts` (publish `proxy_base_url`), `garage-bridge/config.yaml` (`version: "0.3.0"`), `garage-bridge/CHANGELOG.md`, `garage-bridge/DOCS.md` (one paragraph: the proxy URL appears in the app automatically).
